Subject: Request: temporary witness + sandbox access for on-prem deployment evidence

Jonas —

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing the Order Form and need to lock a short witness window and limited sandbox access to complete our internal audit. High level: we want to validate the operator runbook and a forensic snapshot of the runtime image (read-only) in a temporary witness session. Our security folks need: 1) an approved 2-hour witnessing window, 2) access to a non-production sandbox with the same image and a labeled test dataset (no PHI/PII), and 3) a short exhibit in the Order Form that records the witness procedure and handback criteria.

Questions for Redwood:
- Do you offer a timed witness session (on-site or remote) and what is the typical booking lead time?
- Does the proposed exhibit (we attach Biocare_Audit_Request_v1.pdf) align with your custody/escrow alternatives or will we need an additional addendum?
- We need explicit language limiting what we consider "deployment rights" for this session — e.g., inspection only, no derivative use.

Also looping in procurement — we'll follow up on PO path after the exhibit is finalized.

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Head of InfoSec, Biocare Health Systems

Appreciate the detail. Lead time depends on availability for the engineering witness and your preferred timezone — typical booking is 5-10 business days for remote, 3-4 weeks for an on-site witness.

I'm copying Laura (Legal) and David (Product) to confirm compliance and to propose exhibit language. 1) Laura to confirm a short clause we can drop into the Order Form (Exhibit F or an Annex) that captures "inspection-only" rights and the handback rules.
2) David to confirm what we can provide in a sandbox (dataset labeling, logging window, access controls).
3) If Biocare is OK, we prepare a draft Exhibit F and a DocuSign envelope for signature; procurement can attach PO after execution.

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-03-22T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary witness + sandbox access for on-prem deployment evidence

Team —

Quick legal take and suggested redline for an Order Form exhibit. Key principles: limit the scope to verification/inspection, narrow the timeframe, require a written sign-off at handback, and expressly exclude any license grant or derivative rights beyond executing the runtime during the witness session. Below is suggested language I drafted (extract) — please comment.

--- Suggested Exhibit F (extract) ---
Exhibit F — Witnessing & Temporary Sandbox Access
1. Purpose: Customer may request a single, time-boxed witnessing session to verify operator runbook execution and the presence of a specified runtime image. Redwood will provide a read-only copy of the runtime image and a non-production sandbox for the duration of the witnessing session.
2. Scope: Witnessing is limited to observation and documented verification activities; Customer shall not copy, modify, or extract executable artifacts, configuration files, model weights, or datasets. No license to use, distribute, or create derivative works is granted by this Exhibit.
3. Duration and Scheduling: Sessions are by mutual agreement; remote sessions require at least five (5) business days' notice. On-site sessions require additional scheduling and may be subject to an additional fee.
4. Handback and Certification: At session end, Redwood will provide a short signed handback note certifying the sandbox snapshot ID and time window; Customer must destroy any temporary credentials within 24 hours.
5. Forensics & Evidence: Any forensic images provided for witnessing remain Redwood property and are provided solely for inspection; Redwood retains custody and may redact customer-sensitive telemetry.

--- end extract ---

I've attached a tracked version for the team: proposed-exhibit-F-redline.docx. If Product confirms that the sandbox can be constrained as described, I'm comfortable we can proceed with that language and share the draft with Biocare for redlines.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-exhibit-F-redline.docx
